newsitem.title: USA: Minn. Gov. Carlson signs welfare reform bill.
newsitem.headline: Minn. Gov. Carlson signs welfare reform bill.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson has signed welfare reform legislation to bring the state in compliance with federal guidelines, a spokesman said Thursday.
Carlson signed the revenue neutral bill on Wednesday to begin capturing federal block grant dollars available for the program, Brian Dietz said.
The law is also designed to make welfare a neutral factor for people moving to Minnesota, Carlson said in a prepared statement.
